title: What is DOT Mobile?
description: DOT Mobile is an Australian eSIM-only mobile carrier built for digital-first customers. No stores, no plastic SIM.

title: Who is DOT Mobile for?
description: DOT Mobile is built for anyone who wants a simple, digital, contract-free mobile service — especially Gen Z, diaspora communities, and remote workers.

title: What network does DOT Mobile use?
description: DOT Mobile operates on the Telstra wholesale mobile network — 4G and 5G across 98.5% of Australia.

title: Why DOT Mobile is eSIM-only
description: We chose eSIM because it is faster, greener, and more secure than a physical SIM. No waiting, no plastic.

title: How DOT Mobile works
description: Choose a plan, verify your identity, pay, scan your QR code — you are live in minutes. No store visit required.

title: How billing works
description: Your plan renews monthly on the same date. Your card is charged automatically. Here is everything you need to know.

title: When am I charged?
description: You are charged on your renewal date each month — the same calendar date as your original activation.

title: How to change your plan
description: You can upgrade or downgrade your plan any time from your account. Changes take effect at your next renewal date.

title: What happens when my data runs out?
description: On Starter and Core, your speed drops to 1 Mbps for the rest of the billing cycle. You are never charged extra.

title: Data add-ons
description: Purchase a one-off data top-up to restore full speeds on Starter or Core plans mid-cycle.

title: How to cancel your subscription
description: Cancel anytime from your account with no fees. Service stays active until the end of your current billing period.
